seo.title: About us: crypto tax with data engineering | Cleriontax
seo.description: Cleriontax is the investment and crypto tax branch of the Benavides firm: data engineering and tax judgement for portfolios a general practice can't reach.

hero.h1: Crypto tax didn't fit in a general practice. That's why we exist.
hero.subheading: We are the branch of the Benavides firm dedicated to the taxation of investments and crypto assets: a small team that treats data with an engineer's rigour and tax with an adviser's judgement.

parrafos: Cleriontax was born inside the Benavides firm to handle what a general practice cannot cover in the depth it deserves: the taxation of investments and crypto assets.

That kind of taxation calls for a different way of working. Portfolios are spread across exchanges, wallets and protocols; a single person can rack up thousands of transactions a year; and many of the criteria are still being set by the tax authority. A spreadsheet and good intentions are not enough.
That's why we are a team of our own, backed by Benavides and dedicated to this alone.

equipo.h2: Behind every figure there's someone who has checked it

personas.body: Handles the technical side: how each client's data is gathered, cleaned and reconciled until thousands of scattered transactions become a reconciled, traceable portfolio.
personas.foco: the data tells the whole story.

personas.body: Handles the tax side: what is taxed and how, which criterion applies in each doubtful case, and how it is declared and defended before the Spanish Tax Agency.

trato.h2: A boutique firm: few clients and a lot of conversation
principios: We tell you before you ask.
You always talk to whoever handles your case.
Every figure comes with its reason.

chat.titulo: A message from us, on any given Tuesday

mensajes.texto: Hi. Your Kraken balance at 31 December is over €50,000, so this year you need to file Form 721. The deadline is 31 March. Shall we prepare it?
I had no idea. Yes, go ahead.
Done and filed. The receipt and the valuation of each balance are in your folder.

cierre.body: Tell us what you're dealing with. A person will reply, not a form.
